source: create a boat racing game, roblox McDonald are present in every boat with the text saying"inspired by McDonald. Boat are in line to start the race

answers.ask: No setting was stated - open sea, a river, a harbour, or a stylized water park?
answers.answer: Use a simple open-sea racing setting with a clear starting line and race course.

answers.ask: Is this one run from a start to a finish, or laps around a water circuit?
answers.answer: Make it one straight run from the starting line to a finish line.

answers.ask: How many boats line up at the start?
answers.answer: Line up 4 boats at the start.

## Enriched image prompt
Build a simple open-sea boat-racing course as one straight run from a clearly marked start line to a visible finish line. Line up exactly four boats side by side in evenly spaced starting slots, all facing down the course. Mark four readable water corridors with floating buoys or lane markers so the route stays straight and uncluttered across the open sea. Give every boat an original red-and-yellow fast-food-inspired decal and small text treatment without copying a protected restaurant logo, name, or branded character. Keep the course compact enough that the starting grid, long water run, and finish structure read together.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Racing, canonical slug `racing`, because the boats compete along a finite course from a start line to a finish.

## Shape and preset
Use `route-point-to-point`, spelled Point to Point in Racing, for one straight open-sea run. Match the Sprint / Drag preset and add a four-slot starting grid for the stated boat lineup.

## Config requirements
Use `startpoint-line` for the visible sea start line, `lane-corridor` for four buoy-marked water corridors, `trigger-finish` for the visible finish gate or line, `spawn-grid` for four side-by-side launch slots, and universal `water-body` for the open sea. The requested commercial reference is adapted into original fast-food-inspired color and signage rather than copied trademarked branding.

## Layout requirements
Place the layout half of `startpoint-line` across the four course lanes. Place the layout half of `spawn-grid` as exactly four evenly spaced boat SpawnZones immediately behind that line. Place the layout half of `trigger-finish` as one TriggerZone spanning all four lanes at the course end. Place one `checkpoint-respawn` at the starting grid, oriented toward the finish, for wreck recovery.

## Layout components
Create one straight water course, one four-slot start grid, exactly four starting boats, four marked racing corridors, regularly spaced floating lane markers, open sea on both sides, and one finish structure at the far end. Keep the route free of turns, islands, obstacles, and self-crossings, and frame the entire point-to-point plan clearly.

## Render order
Use `authored_plan`: generate the straight four-lane point-to-point course in code first, then produce top-down and isometric dressed views from that blueprint; the authored plan is authoritative because a racing route must be continuous and supported point-to-point tracks can be computed.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale for a compact few-hundred-stud straight course with legible boats and lane markers. The theme is simple open-sea racing with original playful fast-food-inspired boat decoration. Use `P6` because the race route must be valid by construction and `CHECK` because the course occupies a water play surface.
